name: SUNCON
recent: Sunway Construction 近期获得两份大型数据中心合约，总值约 RM1.74 billion 及 US$657 million，同时雇员公积金局（EPF）连续多日申报持股变动，公司也因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股。最新季度（2026年6月30日）营收同比下滑31.1%，但净利同比上升23.5%。
notable: 获得价值 RM1.74 billion 的雪兰莪 Serendah 超大规模数据中心建设合约。
获得总值 US$657 million 的雪兰莪及柔佛数据中心工程合约。
因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，涉及数万股至数万股不等。
risks: EPF 在多个交易日连续申报持股变动，显示大股东持股出现调整。
ESOS 新股发行导致已发行股本逐步增加，存在轻微股权摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 RM1,017.7 million，同比下滑31.1%，环比微降0.5%；净利为 RM103.6 million，同比上升23.5%，环比下降12.5%；净利率为10.2%，低于上一季度的11.6%。

recent_en: Sunway Construction recently secured two major data centre contracts worth approximately RM1.74 billion and US$657 million. The Employees Provident Fund Board has been actively disclosing changes in its shareholding, and the company has issued new shares from ESOS exercises. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 31.1% year-on-year while net profit rose 23.5% year-on-year.
notable_en: Secured a RM1.74 billion hyperscale data centre construction contract in Serendah, Selangor.
Won data centre jobs in Selangor and Johor totalling US$657 million.
Issued new shares from ESOS exercises on multiple occasions, ranging from a few thousand to tens of thousands of shares.
risks_en: EPF made consecutive disclosures of shareholding changes over multiple trading days, indicating adjustments by a substantial shareholder.
ESOS share issuances have gradually increased the issued share capital, resulting in mild equity dilution.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,017.7 million, down 31.1% year-on-year and 0.5% quarter-on-quarter. Net profit was RM103.6 million, up 23.5% year-on-year but down 12.5% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 10.2%, lower than 11.6% in the previous quarter.
